flagship.ar1_rank_long_window.cross_check: extension_scoreboard_1988-2025.csv: rank of ar1 in full-sample mean
flagship.ar1_rank_long_window.spec: AR1's rank by pooled MASE over the FULL 1988-2025 window, all models

flagship.concentration.spec: share of the flagship's k*-margin against its binding rival contributed by the single most influential year -- the same statistic Table 1 reports per curated series (S4)

flagship.condorcet_status.spec: classification of the flagship's pairwise-majority tournament: 'winner' (a Condorcet winner exists), 'cycle' (a genuine intransitive majority cycle, no Condorcet winner), or 'tie' (no Condorcet winner and no cycle -- driven by pairwise ties)

flagship.condorcet_winner.spec: the CONDORCET winner over the flagship's full 1988-2025 window (the model that beats every other model in pairwise per-period majority) -- null if no Condorcet winner exists (a majority cycle or pairwise tie; see flagship.condorcet_status). Completes the same {score, plurality, Condorcet} triple as flagship.pooled_winner/flagship.per_period_winner

flagship.fragile.spec: whether the flagship's pooled winner meets the paper's fixed fragile rule (winner_stability<0.60, or reversal with k*/T<0.25) -- the same rule Table 1 applies per curated series. Computed from the 20-seed-averaged winner_stability (reversal/k_over_T are exact and seed-independent, so only the stability<0.60 half of this rule depends on the bootstrap)

flagship.k_star.spec: decision-level breakdown point -- fewest years whose deletion flips the flagship's pooled winner against its BINDING rival (the opponent that overtakes the champion fastest, named here as `rival`; see flagship.t_binding, which reports the realised statistic for the same pair). k_star is a property of a specific champion-rival pair, not of the champion alone; n_binding_tied flags cells where more than one rival ties for binding

flagship.mcs_10.spec: Hansen (2011) Model Confidence Set at alpha=0.10 on the flagship's 7-model year x model MASE matrix

flagship.mcs_25.spec: Hansen (2011) Model Confidence Set at alpha=0.25 on the flagship's 7-model year x model MASE matrix

flagship.per_period_winner.spec: the per-period (plurality) winner over the flagship's full 1988-2025 window -- compare against flagship.pooled_winner; flagship.reversal reports whether they differ

flagship.pooled_winner.spec: the pooled (score-rule) winner over the flagship's full 1988-2025 window

flagship.responsible_years.spec: the year(s) whose deletion flips the flagship's pooled winner

flagship.reversal.spec: whether the flagship's pooled (score-rule) winner over 1988-2025 differs from its per-period (plurality) winner -- the same statistic Table 1 reports per curated series as its `Reversal` column

flagship.reversal_ambiguous.spec: whether flagship.reversal's verdict rests on an arbitrary per-period plurality tie-break (the per-period winner is one of >=2 models tied for that period) rather than a clean, unambiguous per-period winner -- the flagship-exhibit analogue of election.reversals_lo/election.reversals_hi's tie-break-robustness disclosure for the curated panel

flagship.reversal_condorcet.spec: whether the flagship's pooled (score-rule) winner over 1988-2025 differs from its Condorcet winner (undefined/False when no Condorcet winner exists -- see flagship.condorcet_status) -- the same statistic election.rev_condorcet reports per curated series

flagship.stability_null_median.spec: median winner_stability under EXCHANGEABLE models (K=7, T=38, 20000 panels across 20 independent seeds): what the statistic returns when the winner is arbitrary by construction

flagship.stability_null_p05.spec: 5th percentile of winner_stability under exchangeable models (K=7, T=38) at the flagship's own dimensions; a value below this is unusually fragile RELATIVE TO CHANCE

flagship.stability_null_p95.spec: 95th percentile of winner_stability under exchangeable models (K=7, T=38) at the flagship's own dimensions -- the upper edge of the same band as flagship.stability_null_p05, reported so both tails of the null are on record. The sd here is the p95 edge's OWN seed-to-seed spread, not to be conflated with flagship.stability_null_p05's sd

flagship.winner_stability.spec: block-bootstrap winner-stability for the flagship's pooled winner, averaged over 20 independent bootstrap seeds via NB.stable_stability (seed0= carries the single seed=0 draw for reference)
